findingDetails.title: Level discovery still treats sibling checklist.md as a Level-2 signal
findingDetails.evidence: After a missing SPECKIT_LEVEL header, siblings.includes('checklist.md') returns 2.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop the checklist.md sibling heuristic or retarget it to tasks.md verification sections.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read memory-index-discovery.ts:250-259; heuristic only runs when SPECKIT_LEVEL is absent.
findingDetails.claim: Sibling checklist.md still infers Level 2 after standalone retirement.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: SPECKIT_LEVEL always present so the fallback never runs.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Heuristic is documented memory-taxonomy residue the operator kept.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If every in-scope spec.md carries SPECKIT_LEVEL.
